label: Requeijão cremoso
note: Made from milk curd, not from finished cheese or whey

about.text: The Brazilian spreadable cheese sold in cups, made by melting a drained, washed milk curd with cream or butter and melting salts. Not the Portuguese whey cheese of the same name, which is closer to ricotta.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: melt with cream
how.text: Requeijão cremoso is made by melting a drained, washed milk curd together with cream or butter, which must be added in the 'cremoso' type, giving a smooth, spreadable, mildly acidic product sold in cups.

steps.note: Melted with cream, butter or milkfat; citrate or phosphate salts are allowed.
